acceptable_alternatives: Asking the tenant which day he agreed on the call, as well as the provider.
Correcting the visit date in the system to 16 August only after the provider confirms it.
positive_behaviours: Asks Riverside Works whether 'Willow Utilities', named on the event 026 call, is their engineer or a subcontractor, so the tenant knows who to expect.

Picking one of the two dates and telling the tenant it is confirmed without checking.

Cancelling or re-booking the visit without speaking to the provider.
